usedFor: Encharge holds people and their tags, and Calendly creates the booking link through “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “Tag Added To Person” in Encharge, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A tagged person gets a fresh booking link, so a tag can lead straight to a meeting.

watchOut: “Updated Person” in Encharge fires on every update, so the same person can get another “Create Scheduling Link”.
